# seerr_regions (Data Source)

Fetch supported ISO country and region codes from TMDB for regional watch provider filtering.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Data source identifier.
- `regions` (Attributes List) List of country/region codes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regions))
- `total` (Number) Total number of regions returned.

<a id="nestedatt--regions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `regions`

Read-Only:

- `english_name` (String) English name of the country/region.
- `iso_3166_1` (String) ISO 3166-1 country/region code (e.g. `US`, `GB`, `CA`).
- `name` (String) Native name of the country/region.
